title: Knit bundle list --json
description: What `knit bundle list --json` prints: the bundles in the workspace and where each artifact lives. Archived and deleted bundles appear only with --archived, --deleted or --all. Fields may be added over time, so ignore what you do not know.

activeBundle.description: The bundle that resolves from the current directory, or null when none does.

active.description: True for the bundle named by `activeBundle`.

path.description: The bundle artifact (`schemas/bundle.schema.json`), so a host can read the full record.
